summary: The primary 49cc workflow failed in the conformance runner because --native-go go resolved to a missing checkout/go path, withholding the final matrix check. The artifact nevertheless contains a separate 26-step native CLI replay matching all direct GoScript step states, Views, messages, and effects, plus browser evidence for G/C/P cancellation, stale callback rejection, pending request survival across swap, detached controls, and clean drained unmount. This is bounded mixed evidence, not full CI acceptance.

findings.conformanceGate: rejected: bare --native-go go resolved to /home/runner/work/gondola/gondola/go and failed ENOENT; matrix/lifecycle.native.json and matrix/lifecycle.check.json are absent, so the full checker and mutation controls were withheld
findings.pinStability: 178 source pins and 8 generated-output pins are identical across the conformance attempt stability checks
findings.standaloneNativeGo: separate native-cli stage passed; independently decoded comparison matches all 26 direct emitted-module step states, Views, messages, and effects
findings.cancellationAndGoReplyGuards: native and direct module emit Grandchild, Child, Parent cancellation order; old generation-1 direct messages preserve state/View; sibling and generation-2 replies succeed; duplicate direct replies are no-ops
findings.browserEffectHost: React, DOM, and swap profiles each record 3 canceled callback rejections without ticks, then accept sibling and generation-2 replies; duplicate completion probes are rejected
findings.rendererSwapFences: all four initial request tokens survive the fixed swap; the alternating profile records 16 eligible callback-fenced swaps, 1 ineligible swap, and 32 retired-renderer fence records
findings.detachedPhysicalControls: all three profiles attempt six clicks on detached old subtree controls with unchanged trace, snapshot, callbacks, pending work, effects, and physical HTML
findings.unmountAndErrors: browser profiles unmount with zero pending work and empty physical DOM; pageErrors are empty; separate runtime suite passes 10/10 including pending-work and reentrant unmount cases
findings.traceActionMetadata: injected Go-message actions differ between direct and browser traces at ticks 11, 12, 13, 15, and 25; canonical Go projection excludes action and separate assertions validate the 16 physical clicks, so this field remains un-compared

limits: The workflow and full hosted lifecycle matrix remain failed/rejected; no full CI acceptance is claimed.

The primary browser script forces retired callbacks after subtree removal but before fresh generation-2 requests exist. The stronger live-generation-2-pending sequence is separate E-LIVE-REPLY evidence, not part of this artifact.
Browser unmount occurs after all pending work drains; pending request retirement at unmount is shown by the separate compiled-runtime unit cases, not by the browser scenario.
The full literal native/direct/browser checker and its mutation controls were not reached after the native conformance subprocess spawn failure.
